answer: In Zeotap, audience activation allows you to target and reach users based on the segments you've created. Use the 'Audience Activation' feature to send targeted campaigns.
In Zeotap, source mapping allows you to match incoming data from different sources with your existing customer data. This can be done in the 'Mapping' section of the platform.
In Zeotap, you can create a new data stream by going to the 'Data Streams' section, clicking 'Add New Stream', and following the steps to connect your data source.
To integrate Zeotap with your data sources, navigate to the integrations page and follow the setup instructions.
You can build audience segments in Zeotap by using the Audience Builder tool on the dashboard.
